about.intro: Full-stack developer focused on back-end. Coding since 2020, currently in the final semester of a Computer Science degree. I work with APIs in Java/Spring Boot, Node/TypeScript and PHP and interfaces in React/Next.js, prioritizing architecture, performance, and good practices. My projects run in production — containerized APIs on a VPS, fronts on Vercel, with their own deploy, database, and domain.
